import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { areaType } from "../../../backend/schema/area_type";

export const areaTypeCms = customizeTable<typeof areaType>("area_type", {
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    fields: {
        description: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "name", "gid", "childOrder", "parentRelation", "description"]
});
